fusions.name: Pound the Weights
fusions.desc: Slams the weighted edge of your mesh down all around you, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Flatten the Caught
fusions.desc: Hammers a target carrying one of your afflictions, using that affliction up, dealing 9 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Driven Stakes
fusions.desc: Hammers a row of stakes strung with mesh into the ground ahead of you, a wall 5 tiles long that blocks the way for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Struck While Held
fusions.desc: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying one of your conditions.
